name: Etched Parchment
summary: Gornek gives hunters in the Valley of Trials a summons from Jen'shan. The Etched Parchment points them toward their first lessons in Durotar.

sections.title: A Summons to the Hunt
sections.body: Young orcs and Darkspear trolls begin their rites in the Valley of Trials. As recruits prove themselves against the local vermin, Gornek guides them toward their calling. He gives the Etched Parchment to those who will wield bow, gun, and fang. Its message comes from Jen'shan, a skilled hunter trainer seeking fresh eyes and steady hands.

sections.title: The First Lesson
sections.body: Taking the parchment to Jen'shan begins a hunter's training in Durotar. She teaches that the wild path takes dedication: mastering the beasts of the desert demands as much effort as an arcanist's magic or a shaman's work with the spirits. Her summons brings new hunters to lessons in marksmanship and wilderness survival.

faq.q: What is the Etched Parchment for?
faq.answer: The Etched Parchment guides new hunters in the Valley of Trials to their trainer, Jen'shan.
Gornek gives the parchment to young hunters near the Den in the Valley of Trials.
Jen'shan wrote the message. She is a troll hunter trainer in the Valley of Trials, ready to train new marksmen.
Jen'shan waits in the Valley of Trials in Durotar, near the training grounds, to instruct novice orc and troll hunters.

angles.text: As a hunter, you receive this missive as your first rite of passage in Durotar. It connects you with Jen'shan, who teaches tracking, ranged weapons, and survival.
As a member of the Horde, you hone your craft. For a hunter, this parchment marks the first step toward feeding your clan and guarding Durotar's borders.
